newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hang Lung to sell project to Sino.
newsitem.headline: Hang Lung to sell project to Sino.

text.p: Hang Lung Development Co Ltd said on Monday it secured a contract on December 19 to dispose of its entire interest in a hotel development project to a Sino Land Co Ltd subsidiary for HK$1.07 billion.
The project, held by a wholly-owned unit of Hang Lung, is in Hong Kong's Yau Kom Tau, the firm said in a statement.
The 4,700-square-metre site is being developed into a 438-room hotel with about 18,598 square metres of gross floor area.
The transaction is expected to be completed during the first half of 1998 when the hotel will be delivered to the buyer, the statement said.
